summary: Every poll issues IOCTL_DISK_PERFORMANCE on each volume; this may change kernel counter state, against the read-only claim
evidence: mod.rs:1 says read-only; sysinfo disk.rs:215-216, 476-485. UNVERIFIED: Microsoft IOCTL semantics (no local docs).
failure_scenario: If the IOCTL enables counters, the adapter is not strictly read-only. Needs verification on Windows.
